title: Entity Input Switch
text: Switch input entities, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Switching criterion} sets input port switch criterion Round; {Number of input ports} sets the number of input ports, {Active port selection} sets the active input, {Initial port selection} sets the initial input port for entity entry and {Seed} sets the seed for the random number generator to determine the input. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of input ports
params.values: Specify the number of input ports 2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Active port selection
params.values: Specify the active input port All (default) | Switch

params.name: Switching criterion
params.values: Specify input port switch criterion Round robin (default) | From control port | Equiprobable

params.name: Initial port selection
params.values: Specify the initial input port for entity entry 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Seed
params.values: Specify the seed for the random number generator to determine the input port 23453 (default) | scalar
